query:
insert into TestCaseLogs (
                            latest_collection,
                            product_id,
                            test_run_name,
                            test_case_name,
                            log_src,
                            log_hash
                        )
                        values (
                            $1,
                            $2,
                            $3,
                            $4,
                            $5,
                            $6
                        )
                        on conflict (
                            product_id,
                            test_run_name,
                            test_case_name,
                            log_src
                        ) do update
                        set
                            latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                            log_hash = excluded.log_hash
